items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-146 (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical zero-day vulnerability (StyleSmuggler) that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source installations. Adobe is aware of active exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-138
items.summary: This regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this update.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB26-92
items.summary: This security update addresses critical and important vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce | APSB25-88 (SessionReaper)
items.summary: This update resolves a critical vulnerability, dubbed 'SessionReaper,' that allows unauthenticated remote code execution and customer account takeover under certain conditions. Adobe became aware of CVE-2025-54236 being exploited in the wild, with mass attacks observed.
